## Summary

Machine learning scientist with 8 years of experience turning predictive models into business decisions. I combine machine learning with operations research (MILP, convex optimization, dynamic programming) to solve pricing, forecasting, scheduling and allocation problems. PhD in Computer Science on predict-and-optimize methods, with industry research alongside H&M.
